title: The review's judgement is still not a typed field: the PR body carries status+summary, not a review verdict like NOT READY
body: The learnings record that a review once said NOT READY while the run recorded verdict: ready-to-merge, and the rule taken was that a role whose answer is a judgement needs that judgement as a typed field with an effect. The role_result envelope still has no such field, so the PR body this tick composes carries the review's status and summary — the closest durable thing — not a typed verdict. When a typed review-verdict field lands, closeoutPRBody should compose from it.
